frequency_question: How often do nations successfully renew or replace expiring water-sharing treaties before expiration?
membership_rule: Includes formal bilateral river or water resource treaties with defined expiration dates or mandatory renewal/review clauses. Excludes domestic water management, multilateral frameworks without specific bilateral quotas, and informal understandings lacking treaty status.
window: Within the final 24 months preceding treaty expiration.
provenance_note: rate of 100% from only 6 case(s); too few to establish an extreme base rate -- treat as directional
coverage_note: 6 named major foundational transboundary treaties; population represents the primary global instances of major bilateral river sharing frameworks.
known_gaps: Minor bilateral accords with less formal institutional structures are excluded, focusing strictly on major binding treaties.
skeleton: 6 named historic major transboundary water treaty renegotiations or renewals.
multiplier: 6 hits out of 6 major historical precedents = 1.0
validity_reason: International legal frameworks governing transboundary water resource renewals change slowly over multi-decadal horizons.
